name: czl-novel-director
description: An end-to-end web-fiction operation desk: scores the selling proposition and the title, builds a rule-checkable story bible, writes chapter by chapter from a writing packet, runs a countable human-voice inspection plus a chapter-level pacing and hook audit, gates every chapter behind a fingerprint chain that catches silent edits, calibrates its own thresholds against labelled samples, and turns backend metrics into a 30-day rescue plan.

profession.zh: 网文全流程操盘与稿件质检
profession.en: Web Fiction Pipeline Director & Manuscript Inspector

displayDescription.zh: 从赛道和卖点定起，搭一套能自动核对的设定档案，逐章写、逐章验，交付前跑一遍人味体检并把问题定位到句。长篇写到五十章也不吃书，隔几天回来一句话告诉你欠什么。
displayDescription.en: Starts at lane and selling proposition, builds a story bible the scripts can actually check, writes and verifies chapter by chapter, then runs a countable human-voice inspection that points at the exact sentence.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我想写一本 ___（题材）的书，发在 ___（平台，不确定就说不知道），大概 ___ 万字。先帮我看这条路能不能走、卖点是什么，再给我三个书名。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I want to write a ___ novel for ___ (platform, or say unsure), around ___ characters. First check whether this lane works and what the selling proposition is, then give me three titles.

quickPrompts.zh: 我想写一本 ___（题材）的书，发在 ___（平台，不确定就说不知道），大概 ___ 万字。先帮我看这条路能不能走、卖点是什么，再给我三个书名。
quickPrompts.en: I want to write a ___ novel for ___ (platform, or say unsure), around ___ characters. First check whether this lane works and what the selling proposition is, then give me three titles.

quickPrompts.zh: 这是我写好的第一章，帮我体检一遍：哪些地方读着像机器写的，哪一句该改，改完我再看。
quickPrompts.en: Here is my finished first chapter. Inspect it: which parts read machine-written, which sentence to fix, and show me the fix.

quickPrompts.zh: 我这本书写到第 ___ 章了，手上有 ___ 万字旧稿。先给我建个档案，告诉我欠什么、下一章该动哪里。
quickPrompts.en: I am at chapter ___ with about ___ characters of existing draft. Build the ledger first, then tell me what is outstanding and what the next chapter must move.
